title: ObligationDischargeReceipt
description: E4 (plan: 'obligation-discharge' -- Certification requires all blocking obligations discharged). Binds one obligation_id to the action_digest of the run it was discharged for, and the discharger identity/role that attests it. Fixes an E2 caveat: E2's issue_permit only accepted a caller-asserted set of acknowledged_obligations (a bare string is not evidence); this receipt is the VERIFIED evidence a blocking obligation is actually discharged -- wire.certification.certify() counts an obligation discharged only when a matching instance of this object E1-verify()s (signature, trust binding, expiry, revocation) and binds the same action_digest, never from a caller-supplied list alone.

prev_digest.description: OPTIONAL: the subject_digest (NOT the signature, NOT a whole-envelope hash) of the immediately preceding object in a chain this receipt participates in; absent only on a chain's first (genesis) element. See wire/chain.py:verify_chain and wire/audit_chain.py:audit_chain_verify.
